subject: Insurance
title: Rain Insurance for Outdoor Events
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Rain Insurance for Outdoor Events.

hook.text: Outdoor festival organizers buy weather insurance that pays if rainfall exceeds a set amount on event day.

buildup.text: A music festival investing $5 million can be ruined by one rainy weekend.

discovery.text: These are parametric policies: if the weather station records 0.5 inches of rain, the policy pays automatically.

twist.text: Attendees still get wet despite the policy paying. Insurance helps the organizer, not the soggy concertgoer.

climax.text: Weather insurance is a bet on nature with a weather station as the referee. Simple, fast, and binary.

punchline.text: 0.5 inches of rain triggers the payout. Simple, automatic, done.

quiz.question: How does rain insurance for events typically pay out?
options: Automatically when a weather station records a set rainfall threshold
Only if the event is cancelled
